title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
before: Training used SGD with hand-tuned learning-rate schedules per task.
problem: Learning rates that suit one parameter suit another badly, and tuning was fragile.
breakthrough: Per-parameter adaptive step sizes from running estimates of gradient mean and variance.
why: Almost every transformer since has been trained with Adam or a close variant. It removed a whole class of tuning failure.
next: AdamW, and the optimizer-state sharding that ZeRO later required.
inherits: The default optimizer of the field.
